It now refuses with a clear message, exits 1 and creates nothing (no database, no folder, no archive).\n2. `app/cli.py` inside-the-repository check could be bypassed on macOS's case-insensitive filesystem when the target folder did not exist yet (e.g. `~/Code/iphs400-mp2-cms/newdir`). It now takes the nearest existing ancestor and compares by file identity (`os.path.samefile`), which covers case and symlinks.\n3. `app/cli.py` the zip was written straight to its final name, so a failure left a truncated archive, and a same-minute re-run silently overwrote the earlier one. It now writes to a temp file in the target folder and links it into place only on success (it fails rather than overwrites). An existing archive of the same name is refused with a clear message. The ticket's name format is unchanged.\n4. `app/cli.py` symlinks in `uploads/` were followed, so a link to a file outside the folder put that file in the archive. Symlinks are now skipped, and a warning naming each one goes to stderr.\n5. `app/seed.py` `seed_content` was not atomic, because each helper opened its own connection. A failure part-way left a Trip and Recaps behind, and the next run saw the Trip and did nothing. It now runs in one transaction, so a failure leaves nothing and a re-run seeds fully.\n6. `scripts/seed_demo.py` a whitespace-only password passed the missing check. It is now stripped before the check, and counts as missing.\n7. Tests: `test_backup_inside_the_repository_is_refused` deleted every `cms-backup-*.zip` in the repo in its cleanup. It now snapshots first and deletes only the files it created. The symlink-into-the-repository test and the `cms publish` refusal test now assert the message text, not just the exit code.\n\n### Approved explicitly\n8. `.env.example`: `CMS_SITE_TITLE` is now quoted, so `uv run --env-file` does not stop parsing at the spaces and drop the variables after it.\n\n### Corrections to earlier notes\n- The changed assertions are two lines: `tests/test_t00.py:11` and `tests/test_t01.py:73` (the second is parametrized over admin and editor).\n\n### Deferred as known debt (not changed)\n- The absolute path in the missing-image refusal message: it is printed only in the local terminal and holds no secret.\n- The unused fourth field of `DEMO_RECAPS`: harmless, and removing it is outside this review.\n- The helper imports between test files: they work, and untangling them is a refactor of its own.\n\nFull suite after the fixes: 507 passed. Nothing is committed or pushed.\nEOF\n)\" | tail -1"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":390,"cache_read_input_tokens":82009,"output_tokens":1109,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":32},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":390,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1109,"cache_read_input_tokens":82009,"cache_creation_input_tokens":390,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":390},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01HN8rwaG3rbEZTRUjjm7EpX":{"command":"cd /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && gh issue comment 10 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T09 (uncommitted, on main)\n\n### Found and fixed (each with a failing test written first, shown red, then green)\n1. `app/cli.py` `cms backup` with no database file: it created an empty `cms.db` and archived it. Clone and install:\n\n   ```bash\n   git clone https://github.com/andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms.git\n   cd iphs400-mp2-cms\n   uv sync\n   ```\n\n2. Create `.env` from the template, then edit it and set `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD`\n   and `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` (and a long random `CMS_SECRET_KEY`). Keep values\n   with spaces in double quotes. `.env` is gitignored.\n\n   ```bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   ```\n\n3. Seed the demo Admin and Editor accounts, a Trip, Recaps in every status and\n   two Pages. It is safe to run again.\n\n   ```bash\n   uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\n   ```\n\n4. Start the admin console and open <http://localhost:8000/login>. Log in as\n   `admin@example.test` or `editor@example.test` with the passwords from `.env`.\n\n   ```bash\n   uv run --env-file .env cms serve\n   ```\n\n5. Render the published content into `site/` (generated; never edit it by hand).\n   Preview it with `python3 -m http.server -d site 8001`.\n\n   ```bash\n   uv run --env-file .env cms publish\n   ```\n\n6. Back up the database and uploaded images into a folder **outside** the\n   repository (the command refuses a folder inside it):\n\n   ```bash\n   uv run --env-file .env cms backup ~/cms-backups\n   ```\n\n7. Push `site/` to the `gh-pages` branch, then in the repository's Settings ->\n   Pages choose **Deploy from a branch**, `gh-pages`, `/ (root)`:\n\n   ```bash\n   uv run --env-file .env cms deploy\n   ```\n\n'''\ns=s[:a]+run+s[b:]\na=s.index('Two functions are deliberately'); The skills I ran were grill-with-docs, to-spec, to-tickets, implement, tdd, code-review, and handoff. I also ran research subagents to look up WordPress functions for my field notes, and used /clear and /compact to manage context. The grill decisions were mine, including reversing the model's admins-only account design so Editors can log in at club meetings, and the rule that Editors see only their own Recaps.\n\nTwo prompts I used:\n1. \"Write the new tests first and run them. I used Claude Opus 5.5 for the grilling, spec, and ticket breakdown, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort for implementing and reviewing each ticket. The skills I ran were grill-with-docs, to-spec, to-tickets, implement, tdd, code-review, and handoff. I also ran research subagents to look up WordPress functions for my field notes, and used /clear and /compact to manage context. The grill decisions were mine, including reversing the model's admins-only account design so Editors can log in at club meetings, and the rule that Editors see only their own Recaps.\n\nTwo prompts I used:\n1. \"Write the new tests first and run them. Show me the red run, then STOP and wait for me to say go before you write any implementation code.\"\n2. \"Stop. Answer these before doing anything else, with no changes to files. (1) Did you write tests/test_t05.py before any implementation code? (2) Did you run them and see them fail before implementing, and where in this session can I see that?\"\n\nOne real failure: on the first ticket the model implemented before showing a failing test, even though the workflow requires it. I caught it by asking directly whether it had run the tests red first, and it admitted it had not. After that I asked for the red run explicitly on every ticket. On T05 my prompt asked to show the red run but did not say to stop, so the model showed it and kept going, and I added an explicit stop to every later prompt.\n'''\ns=s[:a]+'## Generative AI Use Statement\\n\\n'+text\nopen('README.md','w').write(s)\nEOF\ngit diff README.md | sed -n 1,25p; echo ...; git diff README.md | tail -30; git status --short | grep -v transcripts"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

 <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header>{% block header %}<a href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a>{% endblock href=\"/admin/accounts\">Accounts</a>{% endif %}</nav>\n{% for message in take_flashes(request) %}<p role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>{% endfor %}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block header %}{% include \"admin/_header.html\" %}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Recaps</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"/admin/recaps/new\">New Recap</a></p>\n  <form method=\"get\" action=\"/admin/recaps\">\n    <label>Status\n      <select name=\"status\"><option value=\"\">Any</option>\n      {% for s in statuses %}<option value=\"{{ s }}\"{% if selected.status == s %} selected{% endif %}>{{ s | capitalize }}</option>{% endfor %}\n      </select></label>\n    <label>Trip\n      <select name=\"trip\"><option value=\"\">Any</option>\n      {% for t in trips %}<option value=\"{{ t.id }}\"{% if selected.trip == t.id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ t.conference }}</option>{% endfor %}\n      </select></label>\n    {% if account.role == \"admin\" %}\n    <label>Owner\n      <select name=\"owner\"><option value=\"\">Any</option>\n      {% for o in owners %}<option value=\"{{ o.id }}\"{% if selected.owner == o.id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ o.name }}</option>{% endfor %}\n      </select></label>\n    {% endif %}\n    <button type=\"submit\">Filter</button>\n  </form>\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Trip</th><th>Byline</th><th>Owner</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for r in recaps %}\n      <tr>\n        <td><a href=\"/admin/recaps/{{ r.id }}\">{{ r.title }}</a></td>\n        <td>{{ r.trip_name }}</td>\n        <td>{{ r.byline_name }} '{{ r.byline_class_year % 100 }}</td>\n        <td>{{ r.owner_name }}</td><td>{{ r.status | capitalize }}</td>\n        <td>\n          <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/recaps/{{ r.id }}/delete\">\n            <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" W=/private/tmp/shots-work && mkdir -p $W && cat > $W/shots.py <<'EOF'\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nBASE = \"http://127.0.0.1:8140\"\nOUT = Path(\"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/screenshots\")\nenv = {}\nfor line in Path(\"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/.env.example\").read_text().splitlines():\n    if \"=\" in line and not line.startswith(\"#\"):\n        k, _, v = line.partition(\"=\"); env[k] = v.strip().strip('\"')\nwidths = []\n\ndef login(page, email, pw):\n    page.goto(BASE + \"/login\")\n    page.fill('input[name=\"email\"]', email); page.fill('input[name=\"password\"]', pw)\n    page.click('button[type=\"submit\"]'); page.wait_for_url(re.compile(r\"/admin\"))\n\nwith sync_playwright() as p:\n    browser = p.chromium.launch()\n    for width in (1280, 390):\n        def shot(page, name):\n            page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f\"{name}-{width}.png\"), full_page=True)\n            widths.append((width, name, page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")))\n        c = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 800}); pg = c.new_page()\n        pg.goto(BASE + \"/login\"); shot(pg, \"login\"); c.close()\n\n        c = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 800}); pg = c.new_page()\n        login(pg, \"admin@example.test\", env[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"])\n        pg.goto(BASE + \"/admin\"); shot(pg, \"dashboard\")\n        pg.goto(BASE + \"/admin/recaps\"); shot(pg, \"content-list\")\n        assert pg.goto(BASE + \"/admin/accounts\").status == 200; shot(pg, \"users\")\n        for extra in (\"/admin/trips\", \"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/accounts/new\", \"/admin/trips/new\", \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/recaps/new\"):\n            pg.goto(BASE + extra); widths.append((width, extra, pg.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")))\n        c.close()\n\n        c = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 800}); pg = c.new_page()\n        login(pg, \"editor@example.test\", env[\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"])\n        pg.goto(BASE + \"/admin/recaps\"); pg.click(\"a:has-text('Lost in the Loop')\")\n        pg.click(\"button:has-text('Preview')\"); pg.wait_for_selector(\"#preview\"); shot(pg, \"editor\")\n        assert pg.goto(BASE + \"/admin/accounts\").status == 403; shot(pg, \"editor-denied\")\n        c.close()\n    browser.close()\nbad = [w for w in widths if w[0] == 390 and w[2] > 390]\nfor w in widths: print(w)\nprint(\"OVERFLOW:\", bad or \"none\")\nEOF\nexport CMS_DATABASE=$W/demo.db CMS_UPLOADS=$W/uploads CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=$(grep ^CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD .env.example | cut -d= -f2) CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=$(grep ^CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD .env.example | cut -d= -f2)\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py && (nohup uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8140 > $W/server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; cd $W && uv run --no-project --with playwright==1.58.0 python shots.py 2>&1 | tail -30"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"a3861e21-b16a-4fd3-a8ba-54ef789dfd81","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMcQPob5Dqo6gyRefUfE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The admin console is now styled, and no page overflows at 390 px. The full suite passes (521 tests), the 12 screenshots are regenerated, and nothing is committed. The two images I showed you are the final `users-390.png` and the first-pass `editor-1280.png`. After that I changed the CSS (see the CSS tweaks below) and regenerated everything. I opened the final `users-390.png` again but did not re-view `editor-1280.png`, so check the final `editor-1280.png` for the textarea width.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Stylesheet:** `app/static/admin.css` is plain CSS with system fonts only. It sets readable typography and a 64 rem max-width layout, styled forms and buttons, a visible `:focus-visible` outline and a `@media (max-width: 40rem)` block. It has no external fonts, no CDN and no inline styles.\n- **`/static` mount:** `app/main.py` mounts only `app/static/` at `/static`. Anything else requested under it, including `/static/../cms.db` and `/static/%2e%2e/cms.db`, returns something other than 200 and never the database.\n- **Link and tables:** `templates/base.html` links `/static/admin.css`. The old relative `style.css` link resolved to nothing under `/admin/...`. The recaps, trips, pages and accounts tables are wrapped in a `table-scroll` div that has `overflow-x: auto`.\n- **Tests:** the earlier 12 failing tests now pass. The traversal test you asked for is in `tests/test_admin_style.py`.\n\n**Width check at 390 px:** I measured `scrollWidth` on 10 pages, and every one is exactly 390. They were login, dashboard, content list, accounts, trips, pages, and the new account, new trip, new page and new recap forms. I also measured the Editor's edit-Recap and 403 pages, and those are 390 too. The tall tables (content list, accounts) now scroll sideways inside their wrapper instead of widening the page. On the accounts table at 390 px, Status and Actions are off-screen until you scroll the table sideways.\n\n**CSS tweaks after the first look:** I changed three rules. Labels that contain a textarea are now block, so the textarea fills the width. The actions cell no longer wraps. Table inputs are no longer forced to 100% width.\n\n**Housekeeping:** the screenshot server is stopped and the temp folder is deleted. `app/static/` is not gitignored, so it will show up when you stage."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":622,"cache_read_input_tokens":137137,"output_tokens":827,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":622,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":827,"cache_read_input_tokens":137137,"cache_creation_input_tokens":622,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":622},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"55b2fb7c-c6ea-4a8a-b4e2-af903532c1b7","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CgMcQNzyPy883w4z2Earm","requestRef":"5f865d0e-87ea-49b8-8157-1e9a78673fd7","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"127a89a9-c3f7-462b-8381-7da07efceda3","timestamp":"2026-10-24T19:26:08.539Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"becf5565-1162-4c68-ba64-e3f14d9ca83a","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"678ec126-720d-4790-bee3-7fde179158ef","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fefc4ad6-b47c-447f-a4ef-c1f0087758e5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PfRoemgVeBSC5c3QqY2DcY","type":"tool_result","content":"(eval):1: no matches found: --include=*.py\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n        return account\n\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block header %}{% include \"admin/_header.html\" %}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Dashboard</h1>\n  <p>You are signed in to the admin console.</p>\n  {% if not_live %}\n  <p role=\"status\" id=\"changes-not-live\">There are changes not yet live. (\"admin screen\", editor.get(\"/admin/accounts?x=<script>alert(1)</script>\",\n                                    headers=HTML)),\n        (\"someone else's recap\", editor.post(\n {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"becf5565-1162-4c68-ba64-e3f14d9ca83a","hash":"c072e023d75785786e3765603cd1bf8b7b1f93718467f428938cdc599b24a196","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01F7MYJ9rHiB1yBEx2mAJYEv","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && cat > tests/test_admin_denied.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"A permission refusal shown to a browser is a styled page with a way back;\nanything that does not ask for HTML keeps the JSON body; the CSRF refusal is\nunchanged.\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03 import make_recap, make_trip\n\nHTML = {\"Accept\": \"text/html,application/xhtml+xml\"}\nMESSAGE = \"You don't have permission to do that\"\n\n\ndef denied_pages(client_as):\n    \"\"\"(label, response) for each way an Editor is refused, asking for HTML.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    other = make_recap(admin, make_trip(admin))\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = csrf_from(editor.get(\"/admin\"))\n    return [\n        (\"admin screen\", editor.get(\"/admin/accounts?x=<script>alert(1)</script>\",\n                                    headers=HTML)),\n        (\"someone else's recap\", editor.post(\n            f\"/admin/recaps/{other}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n            headers=HTML, follow_redirects=False)),\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_a_refusal_for_a_browser_is_a_styled_403_page(client_as):\n    for label, r in denied_pages(client_as):\n        assert r.status_code == 403, label\n        assert r.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\"), label\n        assert MESSAGE in r.text, label\n        assert '<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/static/admin.css\">' in r.text, label\n        assert re.search(r'<a href=\"/admin\">[^<]*[Dd]ashboard[^<]*</a>', r.text), label\n        assert \"Sign out\" in r.text, label                  # the admin header\n        assert '\"detail\"' not in r.text, label\n\n\ndef test_the_refusal_page_shows_no_internals_and_escapes_the_request(client_as):\n    for label, r in denied_pages(client_as):\n        low = r.text.lower()\n        for leak in (\"traceback\", \"app/security\", \"app/routes\", \".py\",\n                     \"<script>alert\"):\n            assert leak not in low, (label, leak)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"headers\", [{}, {\"Accept\": \"*/*\"},\n                                     {\"Accept\": \"application/json\"}])\ndef test_a_refusal_that_does_not_ask_for_html_stays_json(client_as, headers):\n    r = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/accounts\", headers=headers)\n    assert r.status_code == 403\n    assert r.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert r.json() == {\"detail\": \"You do not have permission to do that\"}\n\n\ndef test_the_csrf_refusal_keeps_its_current_behaviour(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for headers in ({}, HTML):\n        r = c.post(\"/admin/recaps\", data={\"csrf_token\": \"wrong\"},\n                   headers=headers, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert r.status_code == 403\n        assert r.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n        assert r.json() == {\"detail\": \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\"}\n\n\ndef test_logged_out_visitors_are_still_sent_to_login(client):\n    r = client.get(\"/admin/accounts\", headers=HTML, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 303 and r.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\nEOF\nuv run pytest tests/test_admin_denied.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E \"^(FAILED|E  )|passed|failed\" | head -20"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"9aa4dc59-1288-4100-825a-b59350a70450","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMcqtjaAeGdiPr1Db2KH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"**STOP 1.** The new tests are in `tests/test_admin_denied.py`, and the two that cover the new behavior are red. 2 failed and 5 passed.\n\n**Red:** both fail because the Editor's refusal comes back as `application/json` when the request accepts HTML. This is the current behavior.\n- `test_a_refusal_for_a_browser_is_a_styled_403_page` checks four things. The page needs a 403 with `text/html`. It needs the message \"You don't have permission to do that\". It needs the `/static/admin.css` link and the admin header. It needs a link to the dashboard (`/admin`).\n- `test_the_refusal_page_shows_no_internals_and_escapes_the_request` checks that the page has no traceback, `.py` paths or `app/...` paths. It also sends `?x=<script>alert(1)</script>` and asserts the script text is not echoed back.\n\nBoth tests cover two refusals with `Accept: text/html`. One is an Editor opening `/admin/accounts`. The other is an Editor deleting a Recap they don't own.\n\n**Green already, and they should stay green:**\n- A request with no `Accept` header, `*/*` or `application/json` still gets 403 with the existing JSON body.\n- The CSRF refusal still returns JSON, with or without `Accept: text/html`.\n- A logged-out visitor is still redirected to `/login` with a 303.\n\nThere is no existing exception handler in the app today; the 403 JSON comes from FastAPI's default handler. After your \"go\" I will add a handler for permission refusals. It will use a small subclass of `HTTPException`, so the CSRF refusal, which is also a 403, is not caught. It will be raised at the two permission sites, `app/security.py:58` and `app/routes/recaps.py:98`. It renders HTML only when `Accept` contains `text/html`, and otherwise falls through to the default JSON.\n\nSay \"go\" to implement."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":441,"cache_read_input_tokens":143922,"output_tokens":639,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":441,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":639,"cache_read_input_tokens":143922,"cache_creation_input_tokens":441,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":441},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"edad94c0-29d2-4880-93f6-4effb25a30b2","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CgMcqtSxe1LCojehLemDD","requestRef":"e10a1d3a-2929-44c2-9eae-71c3a6d86994","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"a546f6d3-f38a-4f11-b9b3-bf1d9a9424c2","timestamp":"2026-10-24T19:31:52.994Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"becf5565-1162-4c68-ba64-e3f14d9ca83a","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"becf5565-1162-4c68-ba64-e3f14d9ca83a","hash":"ef4a4df677469088defc0228cac943840133edee603c7e17caa164237d9fae35","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01YZmSDPYsLLyGRfXVkMj6fd","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && sed -i '' 's/^from app.security import require$/from app.security import PermissionDenied, require/' app/routes/recaps.py && cat > templates/admin/denied.html <<'EOF'\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block header %}{% include \"admin/_header.html\" %}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Not allowed</h1>\n  <p>You don't have permission to do that.</p>\n  <p><a href=\"/admin\">Back to the dashboard</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\np='app/main.py'; s=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace(\"from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\\n\",\"from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\\nfrom fastapi.exception_handlers import http_exception_handler\\n\",1)\ns=s.replace(\"from app.security import csrf_protect\",\"from app.security import PermissionDenied, csrf_protect, current_account\",1)\ns=s.replace(\"    app.include_router(auth.router)\",'''    @app.exception_handler(PermissionDenied)\n    async def permission_denied(request: Request, exc: PermissionDenied):\n        \"\"\"A browser gets a styled page with a way back; anything else keeps\n        the JSON body.\"\"\"\n        account = current_account(request)\n        if \"text/html\" not in request.headers.get(\"accept\", \"\") or account is None:\n            return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/denied.html\", {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"account\": account},\n            status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)''',1)\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncat >> tests/test_admin_denied.py <<'EOF'\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin/trips\", \"/admin/pages\",\n                                  \"/admin/accounts\"])\ndef test_an_editor_opening_an_admin_list_gets_the_styled_page(client_as, path):\n    r = client_as(\"editor\").get(path, headers=HTML)\n    assert r.status_code == 403\n    assert r.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\")\n    assert MESSAGE in r.text\n    assert '<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/static/admin.css\">' in r.text\n    assert '<a href=\"/admin\">' in r.text\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"4c661944-0424-40a8-96f7-b8cadf6d85b9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMd35n9a2W6823j34AD6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"An Editor refused on an Admin screen now sees a styled \"Not allowed\" page with the admin header and a link back to the dashboard. The full suite passes (531 tests) and nothing is committed.\n\n**Sites checked:** only two places refuse for permission, and both now raise the new `PermissionDenied`:\n- `security.py:58` is the `require()` guard. Every `accounts`, `trips`, `pages` and `console` route, and most `recaps` routes, go through it.\n- `recaps.py:98` is the ownership check on a single Recap.\n\nThe other sites don't qualify. Nothing in `images.py` raises a 403. `recaps.py:57` and `recaps.py:72` only use the policy check to filter what a page shows. The CSRF refusal at `security.py:38` is untouched, and so is every 303, 400, 404 and 409.\n\n**What changed:**\n- **Exception:** `PermissionDenied` (a subclass of `HTTPException`, status 403) is in `security.py`. A handler in `app/main.py` renders `templates/admin/denied.html` when the request's `Accept` header contains `text/html`. It falls back to the existing JSON handler for any other `Accept` and for a signed-out request. The template extends the admin base and shows \"You don't have permission to do that\" plus \"Back to the dashboard\".
